chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ‘Ali عليه السلام said:
If it were appropriate for anyone to be stoned twice, the one who commits liwat would be stoned.

key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice; used here for emphasis of severity

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the punishment for liwat in Shia sources?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys the extreme severity of the legal punishment associated with liwat in Shia fiqh language. It presents a forceful statement from Imam ‘Ali عليه السلام emphasizing the gravity of the act within the framework of judicial rulings.
